reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Butler chat priority and Work board controls
reason: Nine collected Python cases cover chat and Work model/API controls, revision checks, idempotent check-ins, bounded Unicode reads, capability discovery, project isolation, and product-knowledge synchronization. One focused frontend case covers preservation of an operator-opened mobile drawer during delayed URL chat restoration. Eight real-Core browser profiles exercise Butler's chat and Work actions and saved UI state after refresh at desktop, compact, Android-sized Chromium, and iPhone-sized WebKit viewports.
exclusions: No native source changed, so no native tests are selected. Unrelated Python, frontend, and Playwright journeys are excluded. The browser profiles emulate mobile devices; physical Safari was not available.
